items.title: Steve Buckingham, interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 25, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I worked in a music store in Richmond, Don Warner Music, and Don Warner gave me a book on music theory

ctx.x: I taught myself theory and how to read. I worked in a music store in Richmond, Don Warner Music, and Don Warner gave me a book on music theory, a little thin book like this, and I taught myself theory, taught myself to read, I taught guitar. I’d stay about two weeks ahead of my students at that time. I was a teenager. But then I started buying books, oh heck, different books on theory to teach myself. And I could read when I was really playing sessions every day, seven days a week. You know you had to learn those…
